about: Session readers that read the whole graph with no scope named, each one of the owner's agreed cases (2026-11-07). graphty-element/test/contracts/working-graph-readers.test.ts proves each still reads the whole graph; tools/check-working-graph.mjs lets this list only shrink. A new reader reads the view, or names the whole graph by its word. The case "not agreed" marks a reader the owner has not seen read the whole graph (design section 11); it is to be agreed or moved to the view. Under accessors, every function that names the whole graph with wholeGraph() (src/session/working/graphs.ts), each with its case; the lint rule local/whole-graph-by-name (eslint-rules/whole-graph-by-name.mjs) fails any other, and tools/check-working-graph.mjs lets this list only shrink too. accessorOwners are the files that hold the store; workingMints the files that may mark a snapshot as the working graph.

The time window's own extent: the track the window is chosen on spans all of time.
